```{r, warning=F, results='hide', message=F}
# Regression Display Function
## This function is useful for rounding estimates and displaying CIs alongside other output.
display.lm <- function(model) {
  df <- summary(model) %>% with(df)
  display.obj <- tidy(model) %>% bind_cols(confint_tidy(model)) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% mutate(p.value.char = ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001", p.value),
                               p.value.3 = round(p.value, 3),
                               ` ` = ifelse(p.value < .001, "***", 
                                            ifelse(p.value < .01, "**", 
                                                   ifelse(p.value < .05, "*", 
                                                          ifelse(p.value < .10, ".", " "))))) %>%
    mutate(p.value = as.character(ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001", p.value.3)),
           df = df[2]) %>%
    select(term, B = estimate, SE = std.error, t = statistic, df, p.value, conf.low, conf.high, ` `) %>%
    mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 2)
  return(display.obj)
}

## Additional steps for formatting kable
kable.lm <- function(display.obj) {
  kable(display.obj, align = c("l", rep('c', ncol(display.obj) - 1))) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive"), 
                  full_width = F, position = "center")
}

# Study 1
S1.full <- read_csv("data/MoralPersuasionData_Study1.csv")  %>% mutate(att1 = (att1_1 + att1_2 + att1_3) / 3,
                              att2 = (att2_1 + att2_2 + att2_3) / 3,
                              attchange = att1 - att2,
                              att.pre = 0 - att1,
                              att.post = 0 - att2,
                              ideology = (poli_soc + poli_econ) / 2) 

## Computing thought favorability
### Coder 1
S1.full$posA <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VA")) == 1, na.rm = T)
S1.full$negA <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VA")) == 2, na.rm = T)
S1.full$neuA <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VA")) == 3, na.rm = T)
S1.full$irrA <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VA")) == 4, na.rm = T)

### Coder 2
S1.full$posB <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VB")) == 1, na.rm = T)
S1.full$negB <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VB")) == 2, na.rm = T)
S1.full$neuB <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VB")) == 3, na.rm = T)
S1.full$irrB <- rowSums(select(S1.full, matches("Th[1-6]VB")) == 4, na.rm = T)

### Average Thought Codings
S1.full$pos <- S1.full %>% select(starts_with("pos")) %>% rowMeans()
S1.full$neg <- S1.full %>% select(starts_with("neg")) %>% rowMeans()
S1.full$neu <- S1.full %>% select(starts_with("neu")) %>% rowMeans()
S1.full$irr <- S1.full %>% select(starts_with("irr")) %>% rowMeans()

S1.full <- mutate(S1.full, cogres = (pos - neg) / (pos + neg + neu))
S1.full$cogres[is.nan(S1.full$cogres)] <- 0 

S1 <- filter(S1.full, att1 >= 0 & duplicatedIP == F)

## Split into Study
S1A <- filter(S1, study.F == "Study 1A")
S1B <- filter(S1, study.F == "Study 1B")


# Study 2
S2.full <- read_csv("data/MoralPersuasionData_Study2.csv") %>% mutate(att1 = (att1_1 + att1_2 + att1_3) / 3,
                              att2 = (att2_1 + att2_2 + att2_3) / 3,
                              attchange = att1 - att2,
                              att.pre = 0 - att1,
                              att.post = 0 - att2,
                              ideology = (poli_soc + poli_econ) / 2,
                              att.post.modZ = abs(att.post - median(att.post)) / mad(att.post)) 
S2.full$pos <- rowSums(select(S2.full, matches("rate[1-6]")) == 2, na.rm = T)
S2.full$neg <- rowSums(select(S2.full, matches("rate[1-6]")) == 1, na.rm = T)
S2.full$neu <- rowSums(select(S2.full, matches("rate[1-6]")) == 3, na.rm = T)
S2.full$irr <- rowSums(select(S2.full, matches("rate[1-6]")) == 4, na.rm = T)
S2.full <- mutate(S2.full, cogres = (pos - neg) / (pos + neg + neu))
S2.full$cogres[is.nan(S2.full$cogres)] <- 0 
S2 <- filter(S2.full, att1 >= 0 & duplicatedIP == F & att.post.modZ < 4)

```

# Language Analysis of Persuasive Messages

The following uses the Moral Foundations LIWC dictionary to code our messages. Note that we omit one of the words in the dictionary ("legal...") which would necessarily capture many cases of "legalize" and other words integral to the marijuana legalization topic itself.

```{r, warning=F, results='hide', message=F}
## Load quanteda
if (!require("quanteda")) install.packages("quanteda") #For text analysis

## Load Message Text
messages <- read_csv("data/messages.csv")

## Load messages and transform to corpus
text <- as.character(messages$text)
corpus <- corpus(text)

## Dictionary Coding
#download.file(url = "http://www.moralfoundations.org/sites/default/files/files/downloads/moral+foundations+dictionary.dic",
#              destfile = "data/MFTdict.dic")
MFT <- readtext("data/MFTdict.dic")
MFT$text <- str_replace(MFT$text, "legal\\*", "") #Removing "legal*" from dictionary
write(as.character(MFT$text[1]), file = "data/MFT_noLegal.dic")

liwcdict <- dictionary(file = "data/MFT_noLegal.dic", format = "LIWC") #Loading dictionary in LIWC format
liwcdfm <- dfm(corpus, dictionary = liwcdict, verbose = FALSE) #Applying dictionary to text
liwc.df <- convert(liwcdfm, to = "data.frame") #Converting results to a dataframe

## Get word counts
words <- str_count(messages$text, '\\s+')+1

## Merge dictionary coding with word count information
text.sum <- cbind(words, liwc.df)
text.sum$document <- str_c("text", 1:6, sep="") #Label text.sum so it can merge back with document information

## Consolidating the "Virtue" vs. "Vice" words.
text.sum$Harm <- text.sum$HarmVice + text.sum$HarmVirtue
text.sum$Fairness <- text.sum$FairnessVice + text.sum$FairnessVirtue
text.sum$Loyalty <-text.sum$IngroupVice + text.sum$IngroupVirtue
text.sum$Authority <- text.sum$AuthorityVice + text.sum$AuthorityVirtue
text.sum$Purity <- text.sum$PurityVice + text.sum$PurityVirtue
```

```{r}
messages %>% inner_join(text.sum) %>% dplyr::select(study, message, words, MoralityGeneral,
                                                    Harm, Fairness, Loyalty, Authority, Purity) %>%
  dplyr::rename('General Morality' = 'MoralityGeneral') %>%
  kable(align = c("l", "l", rep('c', 7))) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed", "responsive", "striped"), 
                  full_width = F, position = "center")
```

The two moral words in the practical message in Study 2 were intentional. These instances are:

* "Although some believe that making marijuana legal is the **moral** thing to do, it is impractical for the following reasons." 
* "It's not a **moral** question but rather a practical one."

# Outlier Criterion in Study 2

Read in data and compute modified Z scores:

```{r}
S1.base <- filter(S1.full, att1 >= 0 & duplicatedIP == F)
S2.base <- filter(S2.full, att1 >= 0 & duplicatedIP == F)

S1.base$modZ <- abs((S1.base$att.post - median(S1.base$att.post)) / mad(S1.base$att.post))
S2.base$modZ <- abs((S2.base$att.post - median(S2.base$att.post)) / mad(S2.base$att.post))
```

<br>

## Moral Basis x Message Type on Post-Message Attitudes

```{r, warning=F, results='hide'}
persuasion <- list()
for(i in c(3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5)) {
  j <- (i * 2) - 5
  print(j)
  tmp1 <- filter(S1.base, modZ < i)
  tmp2 <- filter(S2.base, modZ < i)
  S1.base.out <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor, tmp1) %>% 
    display.lm() %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor") %>%
    mutate(Study = "Study 1", cutoff = i, N = nrow(tmp1), exclude = nrow(S1.base) - nrow(tmp1)) %>% 
    select(Study, cutoff, N, exclude, B, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, ` `)
  S2.base.out <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor, tmp2) %>% 
    display.lm() %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor") %>%
    mutate(Study = "Study 2", cutoff = i, N = nrow(tmp2), exclude = nrow(S2.base) - nrow(tmp2)) %>% 
    select(Study, cutoff, N, exclude, B, conf.low, conf.high, p.value, ` `)
  persuasion[[j]] <- rbind(S1.base.out, S2.base.out)
}
persuasion.df <- do.call(rbind.data.frame, persuasion) %>% mutate(N.ch = str_c("N = ", N))
```

```{r, fig.align = 'center', out.width="100%", fig.height=2.5}
FigS1.1 <- ggplot(persuasion.df, aes(x = cutoff, y = B, color = Study, label = N.ch)) + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(vjust = 1.6, size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high), width = .1) +
  apatheme + ylim(c(-.45, .06)) +
  coord_flip() +
  xlim(c(2.75, 5.15)) +
  theme(text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman", size = 12)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#1A738D", "#D64700"), guide = F) +
  labs(x = "Modified Z Cutoff", y = "Regression Coefficient [95% CI]", 
       title = "A. Moral Basis x Message Type on Post-Message Attitudes") +
  facet_wrap(~Study, nrow = 1)
print(FigS1.1)
#ggsave(plot = FigS1.1, "figures/FigS1A.png", type = "cairo-png", width = 8, height = 2.5)
```

# Internal Meta-Analysis

## Moral Basis x Message Type on Post-Message Attitudes

```{r}
## Study 1A
S1A.ME.test1 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond + base_mor, S1A)
S1A.int.test1 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor, S1A)
S1A.coeff.test1 <- broom::tidy(S1A.int.test1) %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor")

## Study 1B
S1B.ME.test1 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond + base_mor, S1B) 
S1B.int.test1 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor, S1B) 
S1B.coeff.test1 <- broom::tidy(S1B.int.test1) %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor")

## Study 2
S2.ME.test1 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond + base_mor, S2) 
S2.int.test1 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor, S2) 
S2.coeff.test1 <- broom::tidy(S2.int.test1) %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor")

## Relevant data for meta-analysis
meta.test1 <- data.frame(study = c("Study 1A", "Study 1B", "Study 2"),
                         n = c(nrow(S1A), nrow(S1B), nrow(S2)),
                         p = rep(4, 3), #Number of predictors in the model
                         b = c(S1A.coeff.test1$estimate[1], 
                               S1B.coeff.test1$estimate[1], 
                               S2.coeff.test1$estimate[1]),
                         t = c(S1A.coeff.test1$statistic[1], 
                               S1B.coeff.test1$statistic[1], 
                               S2.coeff.test1$statistic[1]),
                         R2Full = c(with(summary(S1A.int.test1), r.squared),
                                    with(summary(S1B.int.test1), r.squared),
                                    with(summary(S2.int.test1), r.squared)),
                         R2Change = c(with(summary(S1A.int.test1), r.squared) - 
                                        with(summary(S1A.ME.test1), r.squared),
                                      with(summary(S1B.int.test1), r.squared - 
                                             with(summary(S1B.ME.test1), r.squared)),
                                      with(summary(S2.int.test1), r.squared - 
                                             with(summary(S2.ME.test1), r.squared)))) %>%
  mutate(f2 = R2Change / (1 - R2Full),
         rp = t / sqrt((t)^2 + (n - p - 1)),
         rp.v = (1 - (rp)^2)^2 / (n - p - 1))

meta.test1 %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 4) %>% kable() %>% kable_styling()
```

```{r}
res.test1 <- rma(yi = rp, vi = rp.v, data = meta.test1, slab = study)
res.test1
```

```{r, out.width="100%"}
forest(res.test1, xlab = "Partial Correlation [95% CI]")
text(-.35, 4.25, "A. Moral Basis x Message Type on Post-Message Attitudes")
```

  mutate(f2 = R2Change / (1 - R2Full),

meta.test2 %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 4) %>% kable() %>% kable_styling()

```{r}

res.test2
```

```{r, out.width="100%"}
forest(res.test2, xlab = "Partial Correlation [95% CI]")
text(-.32, 4.25, "B. Moral Basis x Message Type on Valenced Thoughts")
```

<br>

## Moral Basis x Message Type x Ideology on Post-Message Attitudes

```{r}
## Study 1A
S1A.ME.test3 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor + cond * ideology + base_mor * ideology, S1A)
S1A.int.test3 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor * ideology, S1A)
S1A.coeff.test3 <- broom::tidy(S1A.int.test3) %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor:ideology")

## Study 1B
S1B.ME.test3 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor + cond * ideology + base_mor * ideology, S1B) 
S1B.int.test3 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor * ideology, S1B) 
S1B.coeff.test3 <- broom::tidy(S1B.int.test3) %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor:ideology")

## Study 2
S2.ME.test3 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor + cond * ideology + base_mor * ideology, S2) 
S2.int.test3 <- lm(att.post ~ att.pre + cond * base_mor * ideology, S2) 
S2.coeff.test3 <- broom::tidy(S2.int.test3) %>% filter(term == "cond:base_mor:ideology")

## Relevant data for meta-analysis
meta.test3 <- data.frame(study = c("Study 1A", "Study 1B", "Study 2"),
                         n = c(nrow(S1A), nrow(S1B), nrow(S2)),
                         p = rep(4, 3), #Number of predictors in the model
                         b = c(S1A.coeff.test3$estimate[1], 
                               S1B.coeff.test3$estimate[1], 
                               S2.coeff.test3$estimate[1]),
                         t = c(S1A.coeff.test3$statistic[1], 
                               S1B.coeff.test3$statistic[1], 
                               S2.coeff.test3$statistic[1]),
                         R2Full = c(with(summary(S1A.int.test3), r.squared),
                                    with(summary(S1B.int.test3), r.squared),
                                    with(summary(S2.int.test3), r.squared)),
                         R2Change = c(with(summary(S1A.int.test3), r.squared) - 
                                        with(summary(S1A.ME.test3), r.squared),
                                      with(summary(S1B.int.test3), r.squared - 
                                             with(summary(S1B.ME.test3), r.squared)),
                                      with(summary(S2.int.test3), r.squared - 
                                             with(summary(S2.ME.test3), r.squared)))) %>%
  mutate(f2 = R2Change / (1 - R2Full),
         rp = t / sqrt((t)^2 + (n - p - 1)),
         rp.v = (1 - (rp)^2)^2 / (n - p - 1))

meta.test3 %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 4) %>% kable() %>% kable_styling()
```

```{r}
res.test3 <- rma(yi = rp, vi = rp.v, data = meta.test3, slab = study)
res.test3
```

```{r, out.width="100%"}
forest(res.test3, xlab = "Partial Correlation [95% CI]")
text(-.12, 4.25, "C. Moral Basis x Message Type x Political Orientation on Post-Message Attitutdes")
```
